description:
AI next-day prediction: probability the stock closes UP, a
    paper-trading buy/watch/sell lean (research only, not a trade
    instruction), and how strongly the models agree (consensus).

    Available to every authenticated plan (Free / Pro / Enterprise); subject
    to the caller's plan requests/day and requests/minute limits.

    Args:
        ticker: Stock symbol, e.g. "TSLA".
name: get_ai_prediction
title: AI Prediction
